newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures down on GDP, more data on tap.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures down on GDP, more data on tap.

text.p: April 30 - U.S. debt futures were down after strong Q1 GDP, but trade calmed down from the fast market status seen early. Support in June T-bond at 108-2/32 to 12/32, resistance at 108-21/32. APICS business outlook index rose to 53.4 in April from 51.1 in March. Traders await 0900 CDT Chicago and 0800 CDT New York purchasers data.
